verses.en: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.sm: Ma le usu pese. O le salamo a Tavita. Le ALII e, e olioli le tupu i lou malosi; e matuā fiafia lava ia i lau faaolataga.

verses.en: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.sm: Ua e foaiina ia te ia le manao o lona loto;

verses.en: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.sm: ua e le faafiti foi ia te ia le mea na ole atu ai ona laugutu. Sela. Aua ua tomua mai ia te ia le manuia silisili mai ia te oe;

verses.en: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
verses.sm: ua e faace i lona ao le palealii auro lelei. Na ia faatogaina atu ia te oe ina ia ola,

verses.en: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
verses.sm: ona e foaiina mai ai lea ia te ia o le ola tulu‘i e faavavau faavavau lava. Ua tele lava lona mamalu i lau faaolataga;

verses.en: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
verses.sm: ua e faaeetia i ona luga le viiga ma le matagofie. A4a ua è tuuina ia te ia le manuia e oo i le faavavau;

verses.en: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
verses.sm: ua e faaolioliina o ia i le fiafia i ou luma. Aua ua faatuatua le tupu i le ALII;

verses.en: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
verses.sm: ona o le alofa o lé Silisili ese e le faagaeetia ai o ia. E maua e lou aao o i latou uma o e ita ia te oe;

verses.en: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.sm: e maua lava e lou aao taumatau O e “ino'ino ia te oe. E te faia i latou e pei o le umu aasa i ona po o lou toasa; e faaumatia i latou e le ALII i lona toasa,

verses.en: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.sm: e faaumatia i latou i le au. E fano lava ia te oe o latou gafa ai le lalolagi,

verses.en: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
verses.sm: ma a latou fanau e fano ia nai le fanau a tagata. Aua na latou manatu i se mea leaga ia oo ia te oe;

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
verses.sm: ua latou mafaufau i se togafiti leaga, a e latou te le mafaia. Aua et: faaliutuaina mai i latou, e te saunia au fu‘a e fana atu ai ia te i latou.

verses.en: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
verses.sm: Le ALI e, ia faasilisiliina oe i lou malosi; matou te pepese ma fai pesega i lou mana.
